review_evidence: Declaration grep over 334 listed files: 312 have at least one declaration; 22 have none.

Zero-declaration aggregators read: QuantumAlg/Analysis/QNN.lean (public imports of Trainability and Expressivity plus a module docstring) and QuantumAlg/Util/NumberTheory/Binary/GCD.lean (public imports of FixedRound and Trace plus docstring); the other 19 aggregators (e.g. QNN/Algebras.lean, Util/Classical.lean, Util/RSA.lean, Util/Polynomial.lean) are under 1.3 KB and match the same pattern, several with a namespace/open line, so they are outside the pure-import class or retained per FILTER-007.

QuantumAlg/Analysis/QNN/Designs/QubitTwoDesign/Core/Twirl/PauliNormalizer/Automation.lean has no theorem/def but defines tactic macros (pauliAxisConjFinish, pauliAxisMemFinish, pauliHalfConjFinish) with namespace and open scoped commands: proof automation used by sibling proofs.

QuantumAlg/Util/Polynomial/Complement/Interval/Witness.lean (379232 B) has 360 declaration lines, starting with private theorem multiset_count_le_countP_of, tied to the GSLW19 interval decomposition; hand-written proofs, not data.
QuantumAlg/Util/RSA/ShortLog/Reduction.lean (244274 B) has 200 declaration lines (e.g. def shortLogSecret, def targetExponent) for the Ekera-Hastad RSA reduction.
QuantumAlg/Util/Polynomial/Complement/Laurent/Witness.lean (98459 B) has 112 declaration lines for Laurent complement helpers.
QuantumAlg/Util/NumberTheory/SharedEEA/Alignment/Test.lean is not a test harness: it states and proves theorems comparison_iff and comparison_iff_last about the alignment stopping test.
No listed file contains a line-start #eval, #guard, or #check command.
summary: Surveyed all 334 listed .lean files (QuantumAlg/Analysis and QuantumAlg/Util, 244 B to 379 KB). A line-start declaration grep (theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque, with modifiers) found declarations in 312 files. The 22 files with zero declarations are 21 module aggregators (public imports plus module docstrings, some with namespace/open) and one tactic-macro file; aggregators stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007 because no auxiliary delivery channel is verified, and the macro file defines proof automation. The largest files (Interval/Witness.lean, RSA/ShortLog/Reduction.lean, Laurent/Witness.lean) are hand-written proof developments, not generated data. No file meets the FILTER-002/FILTER-004 bar, so every file is retained.
